description: Pre-guard W16/MOST baseline for GH#1783, GH#1784 and PR#1853; no existing reference outputs were regenerated. Refreshed for GH#1878 (DailyState daily means divided by one step too few): only the rows at 2012-01-01 23:55 and 2012-01-02 00:00 changed. Refreshed for GH#1919 (a run's first day now starts at its first step): again only the rows at 2012-01-01 23:55 and 2012-01-02 00:00 changed. Refreshed for PR#1956 ((z-d)/L relaxed between outer surface-temperature passes; r_a cap and u* floor removed; factor decaying after ten passes): every row changed, by at most 0.76 W m-2 in QH and QE, 0.04 degC in T2 and 0.015 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for PR#1956 with the cal_Stab inner root solve (GH#1962), retaining the 1e-12 m s-1 division guard and decaying outer stability relaxation. Refreshed for PR#1956 review fixes: hidden-root recovery, consistent relaxed scales, and unrelaxed final sign reconciliation. Refreshed for PR#1956 free-convection velocity in the unstable aerodynamic resistance (under-relaxed between outer passes): every row changed, by at most 6.36 W m-2 in QH, 6.31 W m-2 in QE, 0.095 degC in T2 and 0.042 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for PR#1956 effective-wind free-convection term (the whole resistance scales by U/U_e, with no free-convection velocity added to u* in the interfacial part) and the outer-loop settling test ((z-d)/L and the free-convection velocity must also settle, to 0.005, before the loop stops): every row changed, by at most 6.19 W m-2 in QH, 6.33 W m-2 in QE, 0.091 degC in T2 and 0.027 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for GH#2173 (exclude zero-area surfaces from suews_update_tsurf convergence stop criteria): 472/1152 values changed across the first day, by at most 0.06297 W m-2 in QH, 0.1374 W m-2 in QE, 0.004535 degC in T2 and 0.001689 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for PR#1970 (unified CODATA Stefan-Boltzmann constant, double-precision pi, C2K and angle conversions): every row changed, by at most 0.000972 W m-2 in QH, 0.000593 W m-2 in QE, 3.96e-6 degC in T2 and 6.53e-7 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for PR#2326 (match OHM_dqndt_cal_X exponential timescales to 0.5 h + 1.0 h boxcar centroids): 288 rows refreshed, by at most 3.34 W m-2 in QH, 1.42 W m-2 in QE, 0.0109 degC in T2 and 0.00128 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for PR#2388 (align Fortran DailyState accumulation window to right-closed (D 00:00, D+1 00:00], GH#2382): only the final 2 of 288 rows (2012-01-01 23:55 and 2012-01-02 00:00) changed, by at most 4.941 W m-2 in QH, 0.781 W m-2 in QE, 0.0178 degC in T2 and 0.00570 m s-1 in U10. Refreshed for GH#1951 (allocate impervious evaporation shortfall over land-pervious surfaces excluding open water): 173 of 288 rows changed, by at most 1.581 W m-2 in QH and QE, 0.0058 degC in T2 and 0.0003 m s-1 in U10.
configuration: Bundled sample_config.yml, with model.physics.stability=2 and model.physics.roughness_sublayer=0; all other settings unchanged.
execution: SUEWSSimulation.update_config(config, auto_load_forcing=False), update_forcing(forcing), run(start_date=forcing.index[0], end_date=forcing.index[-1], n_jobs=1)
